sources.title: Mass Killing in Poland Becomes Cause for a Political Fight
Poles mourn rare mass killing as authorities say attacker had far-right views
Gunman of Poland mass shooting dies in hospital

en.title: Gunman kills six in Poland on November 9, 2026
en.dek: Gunman with far-right views kills six; government and opposition assign blame
facts: Gunman killed six people in Poland on November 9, 2026
Authorities say the attacker had far-right views
Government blames far right for inspiring the gunman
Opposition accuses government of lax security
Gunman died in hospital following the shooting
body: A gunman with far-right views killed six people in Poland on November 9, 2026, authorities said. The attacker died in hospital following the shooting, according to CNN reports.
The government attributed the attack to far-right influence, stating the gunman was inspired by far-right views. The opposition accused the government of failing to ensure adequate security.
AP News reported that authorities confirmed the attacker had far-right views. Poles mourned the rare mass killing.
en.context: A mass shooting occurred in Poland on November 9, 2026, killing six people. Authorities and political figures have since assigned responsibility for the attack and its circumstances.

pt.title: Homem mata seis pessoas na Polónia em 9 de novembro de 2026
pt.dek: Homem com ideias de extrema-direita mata seis; governo e oposição atribuem culpas
facts: Homem matou seis pessoas na Polónia em 9 de novembro de 2026
Autoridades dizem que o atacante tinha ideias de extrema-direita
Governo culpa a extrema-direita por ter inspirado o atirador
Oposição acusa governo de segurança fraca
Atirador morreu no hospital após o tiroteio
body: Um homem com ideias de extrema-direita matou seis pessoas na Polónia em 9 de novembro de 2026, disseram as autoridades. O atacante morreu no hospital após o tiroteio, segundo relatos da CNN.
O governo atribuiu o ataque à influência da extrema-direita, afirmando que o atirador foi inspirado por essas ideias. A oposição acusou o governo de falhar na garantia de segurança adequada.
A AP News reportou que as autoridades confirmaram que o atacante tinha ideias de extrema-direita. Os polacos lamentaram o raro massacre.
pt.context: Tiroteio massivo ocorreu na Polónia em 9 de novembro de 2026, matando seis pessoas. Autoridades e figuras políticas atribuíram desde então responsabilidade pelo ataque e pelas suas circunstâncias.

zh.title: 波兰枪手在2026年11月9日杀害六人
zh.dek: 枪手持极端右翼观点杀害六人；政府和反对派互相指责
facts: 枪手在波兰于2026年11月9日杀害六人
当局称袭击者持极端右翼观点
政府指责极端右翼煽动枪手
反对派指责政府安保不力
枪手在枪击后身亡于医院
body: 波兰当局称，一名持有极端右翼观点的枪手于2026年11月9日在波兰杀害了六人。根据CNN报道，袭击者在医院因伤势不治身亡。
政府将此次袭击归因于极端右翼影响，称枪手受极端右翼观点激励。在野党则指责政府未能确保足够的安全。
美联社报道，当局确认袭击者持有极端右翼观点。波兰民众哀悼这一少有的大规模枪击事件。
zh.context: 2026年11月9日，波兰发生一起枪击案导致六人遇难。当局和政治人物此后就袭击及其背景归责。

de.title: Schütze tötet in Polen am 9. November 2026 sechs Menschen
de.dek: Schütze mit rechtsextremen Ansichten tötet sechs; Regierung und Opposition legen Schuldige fest
facts: Schütze tötete sechs Menschen in Polen am 9. November 2026
Behörden geben an, der Angreifer hatte rechtsextreme Ansichten
Regierung weist die rechte Szene für die Inspiration des Schützen verantwortlich
Opposition wirft Regierung mangelnde Sicherheitsmaßnahmen vor
Schütze starb im Krankenhaus nach dem Schießereien
body: Eine Schütze mit rechtsextremen Ansichten tötete am 9. November 2026 in Polen sechs Menschen, so teilten Behörden mit. Dem CNN zufolge starb der Angreifer im Krankenhaus nach dem Schusswechsel.

Die Regierung führte den Angriff auf den Einfluss der Rechten zurück und gab an, der Schütze sei von rechtsextremen Ansichten inspiriert gewesen. Die Opposition warf der Regierung vor, eine angemessene Sicherheit nicht gewährleistet zu haben.
AP News berichtete, dass die Behörden bestätigten, der Angreifer habe rechtsextreme Ansichten gehabt. Polen trauerte um den seltenen Massenmord.
de.context: Am 9. November 2026 kam es in Polen zu einem Massenerschießungsdelikt, bei dem sechs Menschen starben. Behörden und politische Akteure haben seitdem die Verantwortung für den Angriff und dessen Umstände zugewiesen.

problemsFixed: Headline uses 'political issue' without attribution; dek uses 'sparking political blame game' which is evaluative; body sentence 1 repeats 'authorities said' without source attribution for the killing claim; sentence 2 uses 'attributed the attack to far-right influence' without naming government source; body contains 'Poles mourned' without attribution; context sentence is evaluative ('has become a political issue'); repeated sentence openings and staccato rhythm; summary sentence at end of body evaluates the event
